reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the $29.99 and the QR with "Every batch lab-tested"; the lab idea is nice, but I already take an 8-form complex that I got for about $15 in a flash sale and it lasts me 3 months, so this is a lot more per month for something I already have covered.
objection: $29.99 for 30 days is about six times what I pay per month now. A QR code and a pretty drawer box do not make me feel I need to pay that when my complex already works.
would_change_my_mind: A flash-sale price around $15 to $18 for the box, or a small trial pack so I can try it for a few dollars first.
